newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in dull trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Monday as buyers stood aside amid rising supply, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,420-25 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but some offers were heard at 1,415 rupiah. Second-half October delivery olein was 1,410 rupiah and November was 1,400 rupiah.
"Buyers were only picking up what they needed immediately," one trader said. "The expectations are that prices will edge down further as supply increases."
"The oil coming in is from local sources. There has been no news of imports," the trader said.
Traders said prices were likely to ease through the week and possibly touch 1,400 rupiah, the lower end of a target set by state logistics agency BULOG.
President Suharto last week ordered BULOG to carry out market operations in a bid to control prices of essential commodities, including cooking oil.
"Looks like there's no need for BULOG to carry out market operations at the moment," one trader said.
